svg.title: Presidential election of 1856, electoral votes by state
svg.desc: Map of the 31 states in 1856 colored by winner. Buchanan, Democrat, won 19 states and 174 electoral votes; Frémont, Republican, won 11 free states and 114; Fillmore, American Party, won Maryland and 8. Territories are gray; boundaries approximate.
svg.text: Electoral votes by state (296 total; 149 needed to win)
